{
  "workflow": {
    "activities": [
      {
        "id": "A1",
        "name": "Trigger Review Initiation",
        "actor": "Responsible party (role unspecified)",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Document update or change event"],
        "outputs": ["Review task initiated"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A2",
        "name": "Obtain Reference Material",
        "actor": "Reviewing engineer",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Specification document (new version)", "Reference material (type unspecified)"],
        "outputs": ["Reference material ready for comparison"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A3",
        "name": "Review Document Against Reference",
        "actor": "Reviewing engineer",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Specification document", "Reference material"],
        "outputs": ["List of identified issues (typos, missing details, incorrect feature reflections)"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A4",
        "name": "Record and Categorize Findings",
        "actor": "Reviewing engineer",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Identified issues"],
        "outputs": ["Documented findings with informal grouping/categorization"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A5",
        "name": "Communicate Findings to Relevant Parties",
        "actor": "Reviewing engineer",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Documented findings"],
        "outputs": ["Findings delivered to content owner / relevant stakeholders"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A6",
        "name": "Resolve Issues in Document",
        "actor": "Content owner / document author (role unspecified)",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Communicated findings"],
        "outputs": ["Updated specification document with corrections applied"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A7",
        "name": "Follow-up Review of Corrections",
        "actor": "Reviewing engineer",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Updated specification document"],
        "outputs": ["Verification result (corrections accepted or further issues noted)"]
      },
      {
        "id": "A8",
        "name": "Final Confirmation / Sign-off",
        "actor": "Responsible party (role unspecified)",
        "system": "Unknown",
        "inputs": ["Verified corrected document"],
        "outputs": ["Review formally closed"]
      }
    ],
    "decisions": [
      {
        "id": "D1",
        "condition": "Are issues found during the document review?",
        "branches": [
          "Issues found → proceed to A4 (Record and Categorize Findings)",
          "No issues found → proceed to A8 (Final Confirmation / Sign-off)"
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "D2",
        "condition": "Are corrections in the updated document accepted during follow-up review?",
        "branches": [
          "Corrections accepted → proceed to A8 (Final Confirmation / Sign-off)",
          "Further issues found → return to A4 (Record and Categorize Findings)"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "exceptions": [
      "Document update trigger is not clearly defined; review may not be initiated consistently",
      "Reference material may be unavailable or outdated, blocking A3",
      "Responsible party for sign-off is unspecified; sign-off step may be delayed or skipped",
      "Communication channel for findings is unknown; findings may be lost or delayed"
    ],
    "dependencies": [
      {"from": "A1", "to": "A2", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A2", "to": "A3", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A3", "to": "D1", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D1", "to": "A4", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D1", "to": "A8", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A4", "to": "A5", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A5", "to": "A6", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A6", "to": "A7", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "A7", "to": "D2", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D2", "to": "A8", "type": "control_flow"},
      {"from": "D2", "to": "A4", "type": "control_flow"}
    ]
  },
  "automation_opportunities": [
    {
      "target": "A1 - Trigger Review Initiation",
      "rationale": "If document versioning or change management tooling is in place, a new document version event could automatically create and assign a review task, eliminating manual initiation.",
      "required_data": ["Document version metadata", "Change event notification", "Reviewer assignment rules"],
      "constraints": ["Trigger mechanism and tooling are currently unspecified", "Reviewer assignment logic must be defined"],
      "confidence": "medium"
    },
    {
      "target": "A3 - Review Document Against Reference",
      "rationale": "Automated diff tools can highlight changes between document versions, reducing manual effort and ensuring no changes are missed.",
      "required_data": ["Previous document version", "Current document version", "Structured document format"],
      "constraints": ["Approach to review is variable; automation would require standardization", "Reference material type must be defined"],
      "confidence": "medium"
    },
    {
      "target": "A4 - Record and Categorize Findings",
      "rationale": "A structured issue-logging template or integration with an issue tracker could automate capture and basic categorization of findings, improving consistency.",
      "required_data": ["Defined issue taxonomy or category schema", "Issue tracking system"],
      "constraints": ["Categorization scheme is currently informal and unspecified", "Tool selection is unknown"],
      "confidence": "low"
    },
    {
      "target": "A5 - Communicate Findings to Relevant Parties",
      "rationale": "Automated notification to content owners upon issue logging would reduce manual communication steps and improve traceability.",
      "required_data": ["Stakeholder contact information", "Issue records", "Communication channel definition"],
      "constraints": ["Communication channel is currently undefined", "Stakeholder roles are not fully specified"],
      "confidence": "low"
    },
    {
      "target": "A8 - Final Confirmation / Sign-off",
      "rationale": "A formal digital sign-off step within a document management or workflow system would provide an auditable closure record.",
      "required_data": ["Identity of sign-off authority", "Workflow or document management system"],
      "constraints": ["Sign-off authority role is unspecified", "No system is currently identified for this step"],
      "confidence": "low"
    }
  ],
  "remaining_gaps": [
    "The specific event or condition that triggers review initiation is not clearly defined (e.g., document publish, version increment, change request approval).",
    "The exact method used to review the document is unclear — it is unknown whether a diff, checklist, full read-through, or another approach is used.",
    "The type and source of reference material used during review have not been specified.",
    "No formal issue classification or severity scheme has been defined; categorization is informal.",
    "The channel or system used to record and communicate findings is unspecified (e.g., inline comments, issue tracker, email, review form).",
    "The roles of additional participants beyond the reviewing engineer are not clearly identified.",
    "The role responsible for resolving issues ('content side') has not been formally named or defined.",
    "The identity and role of the person or group responsible for final sign-off has not been specified.",
    "It is unclear whether the follow-up review is conducted by the same engineer or a different party.",
    "No tooling or systems have been identified for any step in the workflow."
  ]
}
